# Math

<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "math", "name": "math", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:a`, or read elsewhere as `ch('math/a')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
